findings.description: Direct inspection of all eleven current renders and Astra review: left/right side views retain tightly bunched folds; integrated purple hem trim kinks and protrudes in broken pointed segments. Sit and crouch still show lifted panels bunching into angular overlaps beside and behind the thighs, with trim visibly folding out of alignment. Lowering side and under-seat thigh weight did not resolve the deformation.

The current same-pose geometric diagnostic continues to show incomplete overskirt upper-thigh coverage in the seated pose; the measurement does not establish fit or acceptable coverage. Under-shorts sit/crouch coverage remains 63.8%/64.2%, prototype diagnostic only.
Avatar fit and Shape Key response, complete UVs, Unity/VRChat runtime, and release package readiness remain unverified. Keep all quality gates unchanged.

nextAction: Rework the actual side-panel drape and integrated hem-trim path through bent-leg poses using sit/crouch evidence. Do not treat further generic thigh-weight reduction as a fix; first identify the panel/trim deformation mismatch and rebuild its geometry or support. UV remains NOT_CREATED.
